verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of trace sampling rates, log sampling, or selectable retention tiers. Community posts only describe an on/off switch for default log collection (agent env vars and a Data Management Hub 'log settings' toggle). That is an adjacent control, not deliberate sampling or retention-tier management. One user also reports that filtering irrelevant metrics and logs was very hard.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
